ferrite-core:
This mod reduces the memory usage of Minecraft in a few different ways. A high-level technical description of the changes is available here.

The amount of memory saved will depend on the pack. In version 2.5.9 of All Of Fabric 3 it reduces the RAM usage (heap size) from 1,792 MB to 984 MB. For comparison the same setup with Hydrogen instead of FerriteCore uses 1,335 MB. 
These values were measured after generating a world with a fixed seed and waiting for two minutes.
The project picture is a cropped version of this picture.

 FAQ

 Should I install this on the server or just on the client?

Some optimizations are client-side only, but there are some rather high-impact optimizations that are relevant on the server too. So you should install it on both sides.

 Is this compatible with [other mod]?

Most likely yes. The only exception is Hydrogen, which is compatible with all recent Ferri

Inline

Inline is a minecraft library for rendering in-line with text. It has some player facing features, mostly for fun, but also to serve as examples and helpers for future devs.

Check out the gallery for some examples !

 Player Facing Features

 Clientside

Inline comes with a couple of built-in matchers:
- Items -- ex: [item:diamond sword] -- supports any item id
- Entity -- ex: [entity:pig] -- supports any entity type id
- Player heads -- ex: [face:samsthenerd] -- supports player name
- Mod Icon -- ex: [mod:inline] 

You can use various characters in place of the : , some of which modify the size of the render, good for sign labels!
- ; and : are normal size
- , is x0.75 scale
- ! is x1.5 scale
- + is x2 scale

There's a clientside config for upper size limit of in-chat messages to prevent spam from blocking other messages.

You can also prefix any of these with \ to prevent it f

This is required by Project: War Dance, Taoism, Cloak and Dagger, and Combat Circle. It adds some methods and states used between all of them.

The mod provides the ICombatCapability for ItemStacks, which allows custom posture values interpreted on a per-stack basis without having to necessarily install Project: War Dance.

As result, the hot air overlay is completely gone, solving the issue.

A Balanced Diet is a fork of the Diet mod, which facilitates the creation and management of dietary food groups in Minecraft. Diet comes with a default configuration that creates five classical food groups (fruits, grains, vegetables, proteins, and sugars). The mod is highly configurable; users and modpack developers can define their own food groups, classifications, diet effects, notifications, etc.

This fork was created to add some additional clarity, balance, and quality of life features. These would have been made as a PR to the original mod, but the author stated the mod is not likely to have any further 1.20.1 updates. ctn:
This is a simple client side mod that plays a sound when you successfully cooldown trick/attribute swap.

 This mod depends on ukulib to work. 

Config Options:
- Mod Enabled
- Volume
- Pitch
- Sound - An ID for the sound to played.
- Play Mode - When to detect cooldown tricking and play a sound.
 - Self only is the default setting and results in the sound playing only when you successfully cooldown tricks.
 - All players results in the sound playing when anyone successfully cooldown tricks.
 - Others players only results in the sound playing only when other players successfully cooldown tricks.

If you have any issues with the mod, please report them here (and check for replies).

borderless-windowed:
Borderless Windowed

Borderless Windowed replaces Minecraft’s default fullscreen with a borderless windowed mode.

This allows Minecraft to behave like fullscreen while remaining a window, making it easier to alt-tab, use multiple monitors, and avoid screen flickering or resolution changes.

 Features
- Borderless windowed fullscreen
- Faster and smoother alt-tabbing
- No resolution switching
- Works like fullscreen without exclusive mode

 Compatibility
- Fabric mod
- Client-side only
- Compatible with most mods

 Notes
This mod does not change gameplay and only affects how the game window behaves.

brewerylib:
BreweryLib is a lightweight, foundational library required by all mods in the Alehouse Utilities ecosystem. It serves as a central hub for shared code, common functions, and core systems, ensuring that all Alehouse mods work together seamlessly.

By providing a common API and utilities like a standardized logger, BreweryLib streamlines development for the author and guarantees greater stability and compatibility for the end-user. You must install this library for any Alehouse Utilities mods to function correctly. Think of it as the master brewery from which all other Alehouse creations tap their essential ingredients.

CobbleLvlCap is a comprehensive progression utility for Cobblemon that allows server administrators and modpack creators to enforce level limits on players. By assigning specific "tags" to players (e.g., via a permission plugin or commands), you can control the maximum level of Pokemon they can train, use, or capture. This ensures a balanced progression curve and prevents players from skipping content by using over-leveled Pokemon.

 Features 
- Experience Cap: Pokemon strictly stop gaining experience once they reach the player's assigned level cap.
- 
- Battle Enforcement: If a player enters a battle with Pokemon above their cap, those Pokemon are temporarily disabled (fainted) for the duration of the fight to ensure fair play.
- 
- Storage Limits: Prevents players from withdrawing Pokemon from the PC into their party if the Pokemon exceeds their current level limit.
- 
- Safe Trading:

no-way:
A minimalistic mod that disables Waypoints/Locator Bar.

 Features

When installed on the server-side:
 Completely deactivates all waypoint/Locator Bar functionality
 No waypoint or players will be tracked
 Gamerule locator bar will have no effect

Additionally when installed on the client-side:
 Provides a keybind to "Always hide the locator bar"
 Default key: F10 
 "Always hidden" is the default

 Why?

The whole Locator Bar feature is IMHO not mature and was rushed:
 Even when Gamerule locator bar is set to false the server will still track and calculate the movement of players and entities. This is not necessary and causes a performance impact.
 The whole calculation could be done on the client-side without causing additional server load
 No one explicitly asked for this feature (AFAIK), yet it was implemented, enabled by default and declared as ready for production within 14 days

Mana Attributes

This API adds a mana system controlled by entity attributes.

 Default implementation

LivingEntities can have up to manaattributes:max mana amounts of mana. Mana is regenerated by manaattributes:mana regeneration every manaattributes:mana tick threshold ticks.

When mana is reduced, regeneration is stopped for manaattributes:mana regeneration delay threshold ticks.

When mana is <= 0, regeneration is stopped for manaattributes:depleted mana regeneration delay threshold ticks.

 manaattributes:reserved mana describes the percentage amount of maximum mana that is currently not available.

 Default attribute values

- manaattributes:max mana : 0
- manaattributes:mana regeneration : 0
- manaattributes:mana tick threshold : 20
- manaattributes:mana regeneration delay threshold : 20

FastFind

FastFind helps you locate specific items inside any inventory block — chests, furnaces, hoppers, shulker boxes, barrels, you name it. Type what you're looking for and the mod scans nearby containers, marking the right one with an ESP overlay so you're not digging through forty chests by hand.

 Requires installation on both server and client

 Commands

 Command Description

rhenium-mod:
Rhenium

Rhenium is a Fabric performance optimization mod designed to reduce lag in large survival worlds, particularly those with complex redstone contraptions and automated storage systems.

 What it optimizes:

- Hopper throttling — Idle hoppers that have nothing to move are throttled, significantly reducing tick overhead in large storage systems with many hoppers
- Item entity throttling — Stationary ground items tick less frequently, reducing lag in areas with large item piles
- Chest render culling — Chest block entity renderers are skipped beyond 24 blocks, reducing client FPS drops in storage rooms with many chests
- Particle culling - Changes the distance at which the particles are rendered
- Entity culling - Changes the distance in which the entities are rendered

Fully configurable — Every optimization can be toggled individually via Mod Menu, so you keep only what you need.

fabric-title-changer:
Fabric Title Changer

A simple Fabric mod that allows you to customize the text that appears in the title window of Minecraft.

 Configuration
There are 5 options which can be modified by editing the configuration .json file found in minecraft directory/config/fabric-title-changer/settings.json .

- includeVersionNumber : Will hide or remove the version number from the title (1.15.2, etc).
- includeAsterisk : Modded versions now show an asterisk in the title, set this to false to remove it.
- includeNetworkStatus : Minecraft now shows a "Singleplayer", "Multiplayer", "LAN" text in the titlebar. Set this to false to disable this behavior.
- overrideMinecraftTitle : Set a value property on this field to change the "Minecraft" text shown in the titlebar to anything else.
- overrideFullTitle : This will ignore all other settings and force the window to always have the specified title.

 Beacon Bounding Box is a lightweight utility mod that visually displays the area of effect of every beacon in the world using colorful bounding boxes. Each beacon is given a randomly assigned color, making it easy to distinguish between multiple beacons. Even when their ranges overlap.

 Key Features
- Visual range display : See each beacon’s area of effect as a 3D bounding box.
- Random colors : Every beacon gets a unique, randomly generated color.
- Toggle support : Easily toggle the bounding box rendering on or off via a keybind (default G ).
- Conduit support : Now also renders a sphere to show the area of effect of conduits! Default toggle key is H .
- Configurable height : Customize the vertical size of the beacon box in-game using Mod Menu and Cloth Config , or the JSON file in config/beaconrange.json .

Real-time acoustic physics for Minecraft worlds 

 
 
 
 

Features · How it works · Compatibility · Installation · Building · Report a bug

 

 

 What does it do?

Sound changes when a wall stands in the way, when you step out of a room, or when you enter water. AcousticSystem continuously reads the current world geometry, so placing or breaking blocks also affects sounds that are already playing.

 Features

 Occlusion based on wall material and thickness
 Sound propagation around corners, through openings, and along connected structures
 Reflections from walls, floors, and ceilings
 Reverb shaped by room size, openings, and surface materials
 Physical sound transitions between air, water, and lava
 Continuous updates for moving sources, listeners, and changed blocks
 Four quality presets with detailed settings
 JSON-based acoustic properties for blocks and fluids

Apotheotic Creation (NeoForge 1.21.1 Port)
A simple addon that allows defining Create attribute filters for Apotheosis rarities and affixes.
This repository is an unofficial experimental port to Minecraft 1.21.1 using NeoForge, successfully upgraded and refactored with the assistance of [Google Gemini].

 Features
- Filter items processed by Create machinery based on Apothic Equipment (Apotheosis) Loot Rarities .
- Filter items based on Apothic Equipment (Apotheosis) Affixes (e.g., Stalwart, Ironforged).

 Usage
1. Place a filter in a Create component (e.g. Smart Observer, Brass Funnel).
2. Insert an item with an Apothic rarity or an affix into the filter's interface. 
3. The filter UI will read the nested attributes and allow you to configure conditions like:
 - "has 'Uncommon' rarity" 
 - "has the 'Stalwart' affix" 

 Credits & Mod Details
 Original Author: futorX (Created for Forge 1.

Ever earned a stack of achievements and thought "cool, but what did that actually get me?" This mod gives those achievements a point. Every advancement you complete becomes a dupe token, and you spend those tokens to copy whatever item you're holding.

- Local chat by radius (default: 100 blocks)

 Compatibility

- Minecraft: 1.21.1 
- NeoForge: 21.1.222+ 
- Java: 21 

Clients do not need this mod installed: all chat logic runs on the server side.

 How It Works

- A message starting with globalPrefix is sent to all players.

Ninja's Cash is a mod that adds a physical currency to the game. It allows servers to use mods such as the Vending mod whilst still allowing players to buy stuff using the server's economy rather than normal items.

Ninja's Cash uses pictures of genuine British pound coins and notes, as well as British penny coins. The currency is based on GBP (British Pound Sterling).

 Modpacks

You're welcome to use this mod in your modpack - all I ask in return is that you give me credit and reasonably check for updates to use the latest version of this mod for your MC version so that I don't get bug reports for things that are already fixed in newer versions of this mod.

 Downloads

Minecraft Shared Hits Mod

This is a simple Fabric mod that adds a gamerule to share damage taken by players with all other active players. It works on single-player , integrated/LAN servers , and dedicated servers .

Unlike most similar mods, shared hits in this mod share the same damage source, attack type, and direction of attack in addition to the amount of damage. This is not a health sync mod.

 Gamerule

 
/gamerule shareHits [ ]
 

 Default: true 
 When enabled, any damage a player takes is also applied to all other active players.
 Only affects survival mode players; spectators and creative mode players are ignored. 

 Permissions

 Requires operator permissions (level 2) or higher to modify the gamerule just like any other gamerule.

 Notes

 This mod is only required on servers and will be ignored on clients.

- Timer display with configurable countdown
- Cinematic support: run console commands on a schedule when an instruction opens
- Background texture support sent from server to c

The name is in Toki Pona.

So we asked a person who knows of Toki Pona about naming, they told me a bit about how Toki Pona grammar works, and we ended up with ijo pona poki .

- ijo - thing
- pona - good
- poki - container/box/storage

 非脚本模式下 ，NPC 面板中可选的模型与动作数量，完全取决于玩家自己当前动作面板中已有的数量（通过脚本方法调用则不受此数量限制）。

---

 💻 脚本方法 (Script API)
开发人员和地图制作者可以使用以下全新的脚本方法来动态控制 NPC 的 MMD 状态：

 setMmdSkin(modelName, player) 
 为 NPC 绑定指定的 MMD 模型，并实时网络同步给指定的玩家。
 setMmdSkinLocal(modelName) 
 仅在本地为 NPC 绑定 MMD 模型（不进行网络同步）。
 playMmdAnimation(animName) 
 让 NPC 立即播放指定名称的 MMD 动画。
 clearMmdSkin() 
 解除当前 NPC 的 MMD 模型绑定，将其恢复为默认的 Minecraft 渲染模式。
 hasMmdSkin() 
 返回布尔值，检查当前 NPC 是否已经绑定了 MMD 模型。
 getMmdSkinName() 
 获取当前 NPC 所绑定的 MMD 模型名称。

hotshot:
Mojang has fixed this bug in 1.21! 

This mod fixes entities killing other entities with flame and fire aspect not counting towards a kill for the attacker, but rather just a kill from fire damage. 

 The bug: 

Players and entities that kill other entities with the fire from Flame and Fire Aspect do not get credit for these kills as the game thinks the kill is just from fire. This voids looting effects and could break how some mods function.

 The fix: 

If a player or entity inflicts fire damage onto another entity, the attacker is kept track of separately and if the fire damage kills the entity, the original attacker is credited. This allows looting to apply to the kill, achievements to be granted, as well as statistics to be properly increased.

nbt-data-exporter:
NBT Data Exporter
 Introduction

As one of the most common commands, /data get command can read off the NBT data from the targeted block position or entity to the executor.

However, the NBT data cannot be exported to the clipboard/file automatically. This mod aims to solve the problem.

 Usage

After installing the mod, there will be two more game rules. 
They can be set to true on the world creation interface or using the commands /gamerule exportToClipboard true and /gamerule exportToFile true .

Then, when the player enters the /data get command, the NBT data will be exported to the clipboard or file, according to the game rules. The exported file is in the folder .minecraft/export , named the time when the command is executed.

 External Links
 Github (also the issue tracker): https://github.com/QWERTY770/DataExporter
 MCMOD: https://www.mcmod.cn/class/9061.html
 MCBBS: https://www.

Summary

This mod fixes the Class Loader in legacy versions of Minecraft.

 Details

This is a simple jar-mod which adds the CodeSource to each loaded class in FML. 
That is actually everything this mod does (well, besides fixing a few more bugs on even older versions of Forge). 
This mod just ships a backported RelaunchClassLoader which overwrites the built-in version (from FML) and allows mods to read the file source of classes.

 Why is this needed in some cases?

This procedure relies on the CodeSource object of the ProtectionDomain s of the loaded classes.

「虚噬」 是一款以心理恐怖为核心的 Minecraft 模组，主打独特的 Mimic（仿像实体） 机制，为玩家带来沉浸式的恐怖体验。模组摒弃了传统的战斗与生存玩法，转而通过 环境干扰、心理暗示和不可预测的事件 营造紧张氛围，让玩家在熟悉的世界中感受到未知的恐惧。

核心机制与特色

1. Mimic（仿像实体）
◦ 该实体不会主动攻击玩家，而是通过 诡异的行为模式 制造心理压迫感。
◦ 当玩家靠近时，Mimic 会 突然消失，并在原地留下带有神秘文字的告示牌（如 "wait for my return..."）。
◦ 多次遭遇后，Mimic 的行为会逐渐升级，甚至可能 篡改游戏机制（如干扰合成配方）。
 
2. 环境干扰
◦ 玩家可能会遭遇 TNT 陷阱 或 突如其来的推力（如被推下悬崖），增强不可预测性。
◦ 游戏内会随机出现 合成配方异常，短暂改变合成表，让玩家怀疑自己的记忆。
 
3. 心理暗示
◦ 通过 日志警告、闪烁的 UI 或虚假音效 暗示玩家的游戏世界正在被某种存在侵蚀。
◦ 实体生成时没有明显音效，而是依赖 视觉诡计（如突然出现在玩家身后）。
 
4. 轻量级设计
◦ 无需额外维度或复杂机制，所有恐怖元素都基于原版 Minecraft 的玩法改造，兼容性优秀。
◦ 适合整合包制作者或希望在不改变游戏框架的情况下增强恐怖氛围的玩家。
 
适用场景
• 单人恐怖挑战：适合喜欢心理恐怖、追求沉浸感的玩家。
• 服务器整蛊：管理员可手动召唤 Mimic 来惊吓其他玩家。
• 整合包搭配：可与「惊变100天」或「SCP 模组」结合，增强生存模式的压迫感。

minecraft-mongodb-driver:
MongoDB Java Driver for Minecraft

The official MongoDB Java sync driver ( mongodb-driver-sync plus its core and BSON dependencies) repackaged as a Bukkit/Spigot/Paper plugin and a Fabric/Forge/NeoForge mod.

The mod does nothing on its own. Other plugins/mods that want to talk to MongoDB pick this up via softdepend (or just by being on the same classloader) and use the driver via the standard MongoClients.create(...) API.

 What's in the jar

The full sync-driver bundle:

- org.mongodb:mongodb-driver-sync:5.3.1 — the API surface ( MongoClient , MongoCollection , etc.)
- org.mongodb:mongodb-driver-core:5.3.1 — wire-protocol implementation, connection pooling, server discovery
- org.mongodb:bson:5.3.1 — BSON codecs and document model
- org.mongodb:bson-record-codec:5.3.1 — Java record support

Plus minimal loader stubs for Spigot, Forge 1.12, Forge 1.13–1.16, Forge 1.17–1.20, NeoForge 1.2

This mod improves PvE combat on multiplayer servers by making combat feel more responsive under ping. Attacks against mobs register more consistently, critical hits feel closer to singleplayer timing, and ghast fireball deflections are much more reliable.
The mod adjusts its compensation for each player individually based on their latency, so higher ping players get more help where they need it most. Server owners can also fine-tune how strong the compensation is through the config.
It is designed only for PvE and does not change PvP. It does not increase player reach or permanently enlarge entity hitboxes. The goal is simply to reduce the frustration of hits, crits, and fireball deflections failing because of lag.

Mod Comissioned by FlameEliwood

Chat Range

A server-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 that limits chat visibility to a configurable block radius. Players only see messages from others who are nearby — including chat, death messages, notifications, and advancement announcements.

 Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader 0.18.0+
- Fabric API 0.141.3+1.21.11

 Installation

1. Install Fabric Loader for Minecraft 1.21.11.
2. Download Fabric API for 1.21.11 and place it in your mods/ folder.
3. Place chatrange-1.0.0.jar in your server's mods/ folder.
4. Start the server.

The mod is server-side only — clients do not need to install anything.

a-little-more-survival:
What it says on the tin.

Rebalancing survival to do a few things:

1. Damage taken hurts
 
 Regeneration is not disabled per se, it is instead extremely slow. At the same time, it still drains hunger/thirst. Fights end quickly, since immediate, fast regeneration is hard to obtain without multiple caveats.
2. Doing something new should be rewarded
 
 Full protection netherite gear is now only one way to set yourself up, no longer the only viable way. More protective armor slows you down more, at the same time, each piece of armor grants a different bonus to some attribute, allowing for mixing and matching to strengthen a playstyle. The way armor reduces damage has been changed, too, meaning that little armor is still better than no armor, and that high defense does not turn fights into 20 minute slap fights.
3. Survival is tough, but not unfair
 
 There's no random events or sudden attac

 The Minecraft you know. A world that feels new.

Lumora was created to make those moments feel even better.

A carefully crafted experience that brings more beauty, atmosphere and comfort to Minecraft, while preserving everything that makes the original game special.

No complicated progression. No unnecessary distractions. Just a familiar world, thoughtfully refined.

This pack adds the viennese metro (U-Bahn Wien) to Minecraft Transit Railway (MTR). As of Beta-1, some trains of the Type T light metro and Type V/X metros are included, as well as some assets, such as catenary poles for the Type T and some viennese decorations for your world.

 IMPORTANT: This pack requires any edition of Minecraft Transit Railway, version 4.0.0-prerelease.2 or later.
This pack resembles an early state of development. Some vehicles are still rough around the edges, so repaints might get unusuable in the near future. 

 Getting started
This resource pack can be installed like a regular pack. Before you continue, make sure you've enabled the pack in the options menu.

 Coupling the trains
To set up a train, refer to the official MTR tutorials.

Coupling the Type V and Type X stock is pretty straightforward. Cabs are used as the end of a train

mtr-class-357-electrostar-pack:
About 
The British Rail Class 357 Electrostar is a class of alternating current (AC) electric multiple unit (EMU) passenger train built by Adtranz until 2001, later Bombardier, at Derby Litchurch Lane Works between 1999 and 2002. They were delivered in two batches at a cost of approximately £292 million.

 Function 
This resource pack adds new variants of Class 357 Electrostar trains via the MTR mod in c2c, c2c refurbished, c2c Metallic Blue, Great British Railways and c2c Low Emissions liveries.

 Note to the user: The Quiet Zone carriages within this resource pack are designed for MTR4 use, similar to their real-life counterparts, but can also be used with MTR3.

hiddenores:
What does this do?
This resource pack turns every ore in the game hidden. That includes the stone, deepslate, and nether variants. It will appear as if there are no ores. You can use this as a challenge or as a troll.

 How does it work?
It changes the models of ores instead of the textures, so it's compatible with most resource packs.

 What versions does this support?
This resource pack works for versions 1.13 (1.13-pre3) and up.

retro-ps1-shader:
Retro PS1 Shader

Retro screen effects for vanilla Minecraft 26.3+. No Iris, no OptiFine, no mods. Just a resource pack and the new /posteffect command.

11 ready-made looks: old PS1 horror, clean PS1, CRT TV, VHS tape, N64, Game Boy and Silent Hill fog. Each one is a single command.

 How to use

1. Put the pack in your resourcepacks folder and enable it.
2. Turn an effect on:
 /posteffect add @s rppe:ps1 horror 
3. Turn it off:
 /posteffect remove @s rppe:ps1 horror 
 or remove everything:
 /posteffect clear @s 

 Effects

 Name What it looks like 
 --- --- 
 ps1 horror Low resolution, 15-bit color, dithering, grain, dark foggy corners. The main one 
 ps1 horror nodither Same, without the dither pattern 
 ps1 horror novignette Same, without the dark corners 
 ps1 lowres Same, with bigger pixels

This shaderpack is a foundational graphics modification designed to invert the default shading behavior found in vanilla Minecraft. Rather than introducing complex lighting effects, ambient occlusion, or stylized rendering techniques, this pack focuses on a single, deliberate transformation: it reverses the way light and shadow are calculated and displayed in the game’s standard rendering pipeline. This shaderpack flips that logic, causing areas that would normally appear shaded to instead be highlighted, and vice versa. - Battle: PvP is finally enabled and players fight each other until one group/player is remaining.
